lines.speaker: A
lines.english: What time do you wake up every day?

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 我早上七点起床。先喝水，然后洗脸。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zǎoshang qī diǎn qǐchuáng. Xiān hē shuǐ, ránhòu xǐ liǎn.
lines.english: I wake up at 7 AM. First drink water, then wash my face.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: What do you eat for breakfast?

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 吃面包，喝牛奶。有时候吃鸡蛋。
lines.pinyin: Chī miànbāo, hē niúnǎi. Yǒushíhou chī jīdàn.
lines.english: Eat bread, drink milk. Sometimes eat eggs.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: What time do you start work?

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 八点上班。我坐地铁去公司。
lines.pinyin: Bā diǎn shàngbān. Wǒ zuò dìtiě qù gōngsī.
lines.english: Start work at 8. I take the subway to the company.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Do you eat lunch at the company?

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 是的，十二点吃米饭和菜。下午一点休息。
lines.pinyin: Shì de, shí'èr diǎn chī mǐfàn hé cài. Xiàwǔ yī diǎn xiūxi.
lines.english: Yes, eat rice and dishes at 12. Rest at 1 PM in the afternoon.

lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Jǐ diǎn xiàbān? Wǎnshàng zuò shénme?
lines.english: What time off work? What do you do in the evening?

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 六点下班。回家做饭，看书，十点睡觉。
lines.pinyin: Liù diǎn xiàbān. Huíjiā zuòfàn, kànshū, shí diǎn shuìjiào.
lines.english: Off at 6. Go home cook, read, sleep at 10.
